verdict.rationale: Parsec documents a Teams API for deployment automation, audit logs, and reporting, so the axis applies. The evidence never describes issuing API keys or tokens, let alone scoped or least-privilege ones for an agent. 'Granular admin roles through role based access' covers human admin roles, an adjacent control rather than scoped API credentials, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
